hero.description: My world lives somewhere between code and canvas. By day, I work with logic, but at heart, I create. When I paint, I let go of structure and allow colors and emotions to take over. This collection is the meeting point of the two sides of me — a serene balance between order and imagination.

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.description: A collection of moments, sketches, and visions from my painting journey.

about.title: About the Painter
about.paragraph1: Art has always been a quiet part of me, ever since I was a child. But it was only when I started living on my own that something within me awoke again. It felt like a small calling – a gut feeling, a signal from the universe – telling me it was time to reconnect with art. Since that day, painting has become the place where I breathe.
about.paragraph2: I draw warmth and imagination from Miyazaki's worlds, and find peace and light in Monet's expressions, while gradually creating my own. I paint when the day quiets down, when thoughts settle, and colors get to speak. Through my art, I wish to open a window into how I see – and feel – the world. And perhaps inspire others to listen to their own creative joy and inner calling.
